argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='E:\WebAIBridge'; $git=((& git.exe -C $root rev-parse HEAD)|Out-String).Trim(); $dirty=@(& git.exe -C $root status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=no); $h=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/health' -TimeoutSec 7; $op=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/operator-lifecycle' -TimeoutSec 7; $hold=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/projects/control-plane/cutover-r42/status' -TimeoutSec 7; $a=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments' -TimeoutSec 7; $sv=Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/supervisor-watchdog?detect=0' -TimeoutSec 10; Write-Output ('PRODUCTION_HEAD='+$git); Write-Output ('PRODUCTION_DIRTY='+$dirty.Count); Write-Output ('PROD_SERVER_HASH='+(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'app\server.js') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash); Write-Output ('HEALTH='+$h.state); Write-Output ('HEALTH_REASON_COUNT='+@($h.reasons).Count); Write-Output ('HOLD='+$hold.cutoverState.holdActive); Write-Output ('OPERATOR_MODE='+$op.mode); Write-Output ('SUPERVISOR_ENABLED='+$sv.config.enabled); Write-Output ('SUPERVISOR_MODE='+$sv.config.mode); Write-Output ('SUPERVISOR_ALLOW_SEND='+$sv.config.allowAutonomousSend); Write-Output ('SUPERVISOR_AUTO_CONTINUE='+$sv.config.autoContinueEnabled); Write-Output ('ASSIGNMENTS='+@($a.assignments).Count); Write-Output ('QUEUED='+@($a.assignments|Where-Object{$_.state -eq 'queued'}).Count); Write-Output ('ACTIVE='+@($a.assignments|Where-Object{$_.state -in @('running','dispatching','awaiting_evidence')}).Count)
